## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked --all-targets`
- [ ] Documentation or configuration examples were updated if needed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, databases, or private workspace data were added

## UI changes

Include a screenshot or terminal recording for visible changes when useful, and
describe any keyboard or accessibility impact.
